name: test-coverage-review-ts
description: Use before merging a change to the TypeScript (Fastify) backend, or when asked "does this PR have adequate tests?". Read-only reviewer that judges whether a diff carries meaningful, behavior-asserting Vitest coverage against this repo's model (flat test/ dir, mockable repositories, mandatory ops-behavior tests, ≥90% gate). Reports a PASS / CHANGES-REQUESTED verdict with concrete gaps; never edits, stages, or runs the app.
